ticker_news.title: Michael Burry Targets Trump As Oil Soars: 'Falling Stock Market Is His Kryptonite'
ticker_news.description: Michael Burry warns that President Trump may be caught in a dangerous geopolitical spiral as oil prices surge following U.S.-Israel strikes on Iran. With crude jumping roughly 50% since late February and energy markets spiking, a stagflation scenario is emerging that could pressure stock markets. Burry suggests a falling market could become Trump's political weakness, potentially tempting dangerous escalation.
ticker_news.author: Erica Kollmann
